name: Steam
note: Recorded 2026-11-03 on macOS 26. /Applications/Steam.app only starts the real Steam, which runs from ~/Library/Application Support/Steam with the same bundle id and has no window. Steam's main window belongs to a hidden helper, 'Steam Helper' (com.valvesoftware.steam.helper), which has no icon, so without this file the window showed as 'Steam Helper' with a blank icon in Cmd+Tab and the overview.
